# chalk_services_gateway_binding (Resource)

Manages a binding between a Chalk cluster and a services gateway.

**Required permissions:** `project.create` *(team-scoped)*

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chalk_services_gateway_binding" "example" {
  cluster_id          = "your-cluster-id"
  services_gateway_id = "your-services-gateway-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster to bind to the services gateway.
- `services_gateway_id` (String) The ID of the services gateway to bind to the cluster.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Services gateway bindings are imported by cluster ID.
terraform import chalk_services_gateway_binding.example your-cluster-id
```
